title: The All-Over Powder Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ allure 2026 Best of Beauty Award Winner
What it is: A large, fluffy tapered brush with triangular fibers for effortless powder pickup and luxurious all-over application.

Brush Formulation: Powder

Brush Coverage: Full

Brush Handle Length:

Bristle Type: Synthetic

What Else You Need to Know: This artisanal powder brush is intentionally designed to pair with Saie’s Slip Tint Undetectable Baked Setting Powder (sold separately) and powder formulas. It’s made with a unique combination of three types of triangular vegan fibers designed to mimic traditional goat hair. Its slender, 100 percent aluminum handle allows for a delicate hold and effortless application.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Lightly swirl The All-Over Powder Brush on the Slip Tint Undetectable Baked Setting Powder (sold separately) pan.
-Using fluffy bristles, sweep powder onto t-zone: around the nose, chin, forehead, and in between eyebrows.
-Retouch your look as needed.
-Pro tip: For a diffused look and a softer touch, hold the end of the brush handle instead of holding it like a pencil.
